name: Mini Tether
description: Mini Tether (USD) is an ERC-20 token on Ethereum with 6 decimals and 100,000,000,000 supply (the owner can mint more). Its official market is the Uniswap V3 USD/USDT pool (fee 0.05%): a permissionless single-sided USDT position quotes $1.00 for buys and pays out up to ~10 USD per cycle for sells, so the pair trades 1:1 with USDT up to that depth. No transfer gate, blacklist, pause or tax in the contract.
